signatures.description: Build the 0-RTT early-data admission path for a TLS 1.3 server cluster: each PSK ticket may be replayed at most once across all nodes, even though the ticket-key epoch rotates and requests bearing the same ticket can land on different partitions after a network split. Enforce single-use admission with a monotonic epoch fence (rejecting tickets minted before the current rotation boundary), stay correct across partition heal with duplicate in-flight replays, and bound the state so the replay window cannot grow without limit. Include a fault-injection harness driving cold, fenced, partitioned, and exhausted states that proves no double-admission under any interleaving.
